beschreibung:
What happens when Ice Cube and Mike Epps get together on the porch?

Welcome to the Listen & Laugh Podcast, where two longtime friends and cultural icons sit down with some of the biggest names in music, movies, comedy, sports, and culture.

From the streets to the suites, Last Friday to first crushes, big breaks and heartbreaks, classic stories and new debates, the

conversations get real.

The guards come down, the stories get personal, and nothing is off limits.

Cube's gonna make you listen and Epps is gonna make you laugh. And sometimes, it will be the other way around.

New episodes every Friday at 6 PM ET / 3 PM PT. Watch the full episodes on YouTube or listen wherever you get your

podcasts.

Enjoy the official trailer!

Subscribe now and pull up to the porch.
